creatorDecision.lockedVisualReferenceMeaning: Creator likes look, shape, edge treatment and spaciousness. VISUAL PRESERVATION REFERENCE ONLY — NOT permission to reauthor, redraw, widen or recolour the road.

transform.roundtrip: auToTile(tileToAuCentre(tx)) === tx for every in-frame integer tile. tileToAuCentre(auToTile(a)) is a SNAP to the tile centre, not an exact inverse of an arbitrary authored AU coordinate.
transform.polygonReprojection: Every GOLD polygon vertex (xAu,yAu) becomes a continuous tile-space vertex (2*xAu, 2*yAu). Occupancy is evaluated at exact tile centres; vertices are NOT rounded to whole AU or whole tiles before the point-in-polygon test.
snapRules: NO Math.round on player/world position; movement is continuous in pixels and collision is resolved in tile space.
Pixel snapping happens ONLY at draw time (Math.round of integer-pixel screen coordinates), preserving the SOH pixel grid.

The 8 AU WMP-04R1 analysis raster is ANALYSIS DATA, sampled with the LW-01 deterministic 1 AU dither; it is NEVER upscaled as a nearest-neighbour 8 AU square land outline and is NEVER advertised as more authored detail than exists.
Road centreline width stays 3.0 AU (GOLD rd_* unchanged). At U=0.5 that is 6 tiles / 96 px because of the scale transform ONLY; no additional widening, no recolour, no redraw, no edge-rule change.

chunkCoordinates.prohibitedIdentity: cy*100+cx (legacy 200x200 key) aliases for cx>=100 inside this frame; it must never be used.
chunkCoordinates.residentPolicy: Lazy, bounded LRU of at most 36 resident 32x32-tile chunks plus a bounded LRU of rendered 16x16-tile display canvases. No full-frame allocation, no 11.2M-element array, no 4000x2800 canvas.
chunkCoordinates.chunkFromTile: cx = floor(tx/32), cy = floor(ty/32), localX = tx - cx*32, localY = ty - cy*32; linear index = ty*4000 + tx with explicit in-frame validation.
chunkCoordinates.outOfFrame: Negative / >3999 / >2799 tile coordinates return T.DEEP for drawing and are rejected by index(); they never alias another chunk.
chunkCoordinates.renderChunkKey: creator-u05|render16|cx:cy — distinct from the geometry chunk key; no aliasing between the two caches.

hardInvariants: H01 U=0.5, TILE=16 px, 1 AU = 2 runtime tiles = 32 px; frame 4000x2800 (NON-SQUARE), 11,200,000 addressable cells.
H02 Never allocate the whole frame as an array, raster, canvas or texture. Only lazy bounded chunks.
H03 Native camera 640x360 at 1x, hero sprite 16x24, base walking speed 72 px/s, SOH gameplay clock unchanged. No zoom, no scale(), no stretched sprites, no camera trick.
H04 GOLD coast/lake/river/road/dock/POI/zone/resource geometry and all 81 canonical POI IDs are preserved byte-for-byte in source; U=0.5 is an additive reprojection, not a reauthoring.
H05 The Beacon road keeps its GOLD centreline, 3.0 AU width, live-Gameplay PAL/PRIO/texel road palette and edge rule. No widening, recolour or redraw.
H06 GOLD poi.foot polygons are SITE ENVELOPES / MARKERS, NOT certified buildings. A numeric footprint area is NOT evidence of usable room area or physical readiness.
H07 No automatic POI shrink/relocate/expand, no helicopter relocation, no silent canon polygon amendment. Any measured incompatibility is reported with before/after evidence and an owner.
H08 No invented islands, POIs, loot, mystery buildings, random props, bosses, vendor economics, vehicles, cargo/boat/build/cash permission or Gameplay law.
H09 Every authoritative field is classified source-authored | reprojected | proposed | runtime-owned | unresolved.
H10 QA proof is NOT visual acceptance; visual acceptance is NOT gameplay acceptance; neither is a merge/seal/VEYRA_PLAYABLE claim.
H11 Full 4000x2800 streaming / production acceptance is NOT claimed unless exhaustively tested. Six-scene audition is a bounded pilot.
H12 Any gate lacking real runtime/browser/input proof is PARTIAL or FAIL, never prose-PASS.
